title: Roke Zindan Me Yeh Kehti Thi Sakina Baba
body:
Roke Zindan Me Yeh Kehti Thi Sakina Baba
aapke Baad Gawaara Nahi Jeena Baba
1. Neend Aati Nahi Din Raat Yu'nhi Roti Hoo'n
yaad Aata Hai Mujhe Aap Ka Seena Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Bhai Sajjad Ka Bistar Mere Gouhar Cheene
kya Yateemo Ko Yu'nhi Dete Hain Pursa Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Kaan Se Khoon Tapakta Hai Mere Shanou'n Par
is Tarah Shimr Ne Gauhar Mere Cheene Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Karbala Se Jo Chali Shaam Ke Zindaan Talak
mujh Ko Jee Bhar Ke Layeenou'n Ne Sataya Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Pusht Par Oont Ki Bandhey Thay Sitamgar Mujhko
us Aziyat Se Hain Zakhmi Mera Seena Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Mojiza Dekh Ke Haira'n Tha Har Ek Bani-e-shar
aap Ka Sar Meri Godi Mai Jo Aaya Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Aap Ki Beti Pay Us Waqt Qayamat Guzri
us Ko Haakim Ne Kaneezi Me Jo Ma'nga Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Mere Ammu Se Kaho Aake Chudaye'n Jaldi
mujh Ko Kha Jayega Zinda'n Ka Andhera Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Aap Aajaye'n Toh Zinda'n Me Ujala Hoga
mujh Pay Ehsa'n Ye Bada Aap Ka Hoga Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
10. Qalbey Saber Ko Ise Sunke Tasalli Hogi
jab Padha Jayega Mazher Ka Yeh Nouha Baba
